key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 08!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 08!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書08を手に入れた!

key: Info on Swamp Field now available!
en: Info on Swamp Field now available!
ja: スワンプフィールドの情報が見られるようになった!

key: There's something shining on the ground.
en: There's something shining on the ground.
ja: 地面に何か光っている……

key: You recognize it as one of Cain's earrings.
en: You recognize it as one of Cain's earrings.
ja: それがカインのピアスの片方だと気づいた。

key: The boat is idling on the tainted water... It seems to be ready to go.
en: The boat is idling on the tainted water... It seems to be ready to go.
ja: 汚染された水面に、ボートが浮かんでいる……いつでも出発できそうだ。

key: Do you want to ride?
en: Do you want to ride?
ja: 乗りますか?

key: ASTER: Well, well, well, look who it is...
en: ASTER: Well, well, well, look who it is...
ja: アスター: おやおやおや、誰が来たかと思えば……

key: ECLIPSE: Can't say we were expecting you of all people...
en: ECLIPSE: Can't say we were expecting you of all people...
ja: エクリプス: よりによってあんたが来るとはね……

key: Now what would you be doing in a place like this?
en: Now what would you be doing in a place like this?
ja: こんな場所で、一体何やってるわけ?

key: ASTER: Obviously he came to rescue his friend!
en: ASTER: Obviously he came to rescue his friend!
ja: アスター: 決まってるじゃないっスか、友達を助けに来たんスよ!

key: ASTER: Obviously she came to rescue her friend!
en: ASTER: Obviously she came to rescue her friend!
ja: アスター: 決まってるじゃないっスか、友達を助けに来たんスよ!

key: ASTER: Obviously they came to rescue their friend!
en: ASTER: Obviously they came to rescue their friend!
ja: アスター: 決まってるじゃないっスか、友達を助けに来たんスよ!

key: ECLIPSE: Rhetorical questions, Aster?
en: ECLIPSE: Rhetorical questions, Aster?
ja: エクリプス: 修辞疑問文? アスター。

key: Maybe you've heard of them?
en: Maybe you've heard of them?
ja: 聞いたことくらいあるでしょ?

key: ASTER: No, were they part of the mission?
en: ASTER: No, were they part of the mission?
ja: アスター: いや、それって任務の一部だったんスか?

key: ECLIPSE: ...
en: ECLIPSE: ...
ja: エクリプス: ……

key: Say, I can't help but notice...
en: Say, I can't help but notice...
ja: ねえ、気づかずにはいられないんだけど……

key: You've always had a friend with you when you faced us in the past.
en: You've always had a friend with you when you faced us in the past.
ja: これまであんたがあたしたちと対決する時は、いつも友達が一緒だったよね。

key: But now, someone is looking a little bit outnumbered.
en: But now, someone is looking a little bit outnumbered.
ja: でも今は、ちょっとばかり数で負けてるみたいじゃない。

key: ASTER: Two heads are harder than one!
en: ASTER: Two heads are harder than one!
ja: アスター: 頭ふたつは、ひとつより手ごわいっスよ!

key: ECLIPSE: Yours especially.
en: ECLIPSE: Yours especially.
ja: エクリプス: 特にあんたの頭はね。

key: Our orders were clear-- no trespassers allowed!
en: Our orders were clear-- no trespassers allowed!
ja: 命令ははっきりしてる――不法侵入者は許さない!

key: Private property and all that, get the picture?
en: Private property and all that, get the picture?
ja: ここは私有地、ってわけ。わかった?

key: Seriously, again!?
en: Seriously, again!?
ja: マジかよ　また負けたんスか!?

key: Did you expect something else?
en: Did you expect something else?
ja: 他に何か　期待していたの?

key: ECLIPSE: Pity.
en: ECLIPSE: Pity.
ja: エクリプス: 残念。

key: But just as well.
en: But just as well.
ja: でも、ちょうどよかったかも。

key: We were asked to keep a few things of importance here, but it's not as if we'd go leaving them out in the open~
en: We were asked to keep a few things of importance here, but it's not as if we'd go leaving them out in the open~
ja: ここに大事なものを預かってくれって頼まれてるけど、そんなの、あからさまに置いとくわけないでしょ~

key: ASTER: Yeah, you'll never find the secret passage to our lab!
en: ASTER: Yeah, you'll never find the secret passage to our lab!
ja: アスター: そうそう、オレたちの研究所への秘密の通路なんて、絶対見つからないっスよ!

key: ECLIPSE: ...Aster,
en: ECLIPSE: ...Aster,
ja: エクリプス: ……アスター、

key: For once-- just once in your entire life,
en: For once-- just once in your entire life,
ja: 一度でいい――人生で一度でいいから、

key: Could you PLEASE shut up?
en: Could you PLEASE shut up?
ja: お願いだから、黙っててくれない?

key: I am literally begging you.
en: I am literally begging you.
ja: 本当に、心の底からお願いしてるんだけど。

key: You just TOLD \PN that there is one.
en: You just TOLD \PN that there is one.
ja: 今、\PNに「ある」って教えちゃったじゃない。

key: Ugh.
en: Ugh.
ja: はぁ。

key: Look, I'm sympathetic to it all, I really am.
en: Look, I'm sympathetic to it all, I really am.
ja: あのさ、あたしだって、それなりに同情してるんだよ、本当に。

key: I heard about the teacher collapsing.
en: I heard about the teacher collapsing.
ja: 先生が倒れたって話は聞いてる。

key: We've got eyes everywhere, so don't be surprised.
en: We've got eyes everywhere, so don't be surprised.
ja: こっちには至るところに目があるから、驚かないでよね。

key: She's dying, right?
en: She's dying, right?
ja: 死にかけてるんでしょ?

key: I've basically put the dots together.
en: I've basically put the dots together.
ja: だいたい話はつながったし。

key: And I'll tell you, I'm not thrilled to kick someone who's already on the ground.
en: And I'll tell you, I'm not thrilled to kick someone who's already on the ground.
ja: 正直言って、もう倒れてる相手を蹴飛ばすのは気が進まない。

key: My old man has his own issues,
en: My old man has his own issues,
ja: あたしの親父にもいろいろあるし、

key: And you better believe if someone were trying to put him in the grave faster, I wouldn't just let it happen.
en: And you better believe if someone were trying to put him in the grave faster, I wouldn't just let it happen.
ja: 誰かがあいつを早く墓場に送ろうとしてたら、あたしだって黙って見てないよ。

key: But Team Meteor doesn't exactly care about MY sympathies.
en: But Team Meteor doesn't exactly care about MY sympathies.
ja: でも、チームメテオはあたしの同情になんて興味ないから。

key: I'm just a private.
en: I'm just a private.
ja: あたしはただの兵卒。

key: ASTER: You're not just a private, Eclipse!
en: ASTER: You're not just a private, Eclipse!
ja: アスター: ただの兵卒なんかじゃないっスよ、エクリプス!

key: You're my partner, too!
en: You're my partner, too!
ja: オレの相棒でもあるんスから!

key: ECLIPSE: That's really nice, Aster.
en: ECLIPSE: That's really nice, Aster.
ja: エクリプス: それはどうも、アスター。

key: Now could you give us a minute?
en: Now could you give us a minute?
ja: ちょっとだけ、時間もらえる?

key: The adults are talking right now.
en: The adults are talking right now.
ja: 今は大人の話をしてるの。

key: ASTER: But I'm an adult...
en: ASTER: But I'm an adult...
ja: アスター: でも、オレも大人っスけど……

key: ECLIPSE: Sometimes, I wonder.
en: ECLIPSE: Sometimes, I wonder.
ja: エクリプス: 時々、疑わしくなる。

key: Anyway, the idiot already gave you the clue.
en: Anyway, the idiot already gave you the clue.
ja: とにかく、このバカがもうヒントを漏らしちゃったし。

key: All I'm saying is, don't waste it.
en: All I'm saying is, don't waste it.
ja: 言いたいのはただ、無駄にしないでってこと。

key: Back left.
en: Back left.
ja: 奥の左。

key: You didn't hear it from me.
en: You didn't hear it from me.
ja: あたしから聞いたことにはしないでね。

key: Bye.
en: Bye.
ja: じゃあね。

key: Reborn City
en: Reborn City
ja: リボーンシティ

key: Apophyll Beach
en: Apophyll Beach
ja: アポフィルビーチ

key: Nowhere
en: Nowhere
ja: どこにも行かない
